issue.body:
Given that Starlette implements a basic authentication interface at this point, are there any plans to also provide some common password hashing functionality/security utils?

For example, both [Werkzeug](http://werkzeug.pocoo.org/docs/0.14/utils/#module-werkzeug.security) and [Django](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/2.1/topics/auth/passwords/) offer some tools in this regard. I think security is something easy to get wrong and password authentication is a common enough problem to warrant shipping some utils with Starlette as well.

Alternatively, we may want to document recommended approaches/best practices to provide some guidance to those implementing the authentication interface or a third-party extension.
issue.title: Security and password utils
